acceptance: Unit tests on captured logs for Q8, Q39 and Q70 parse to the expected names and values
A test shows two runs with the same seed produce identical parsed output and a different seed differs
Stream number is part of the parsed result
No change to existing query generation behavior when -LOG is not requested
context:
Source: DataFrame query parity proposal v3 (item T1). Not dependent on owner decisions because the parser records everything including stream.

Closed 2026-10-01: merged as PR #2498 (squash, 22:55Z). Evidence per criterion: tests/unit/tpcds/test_parameter_log.py covers Q8, Q39 and Q70 captured logs (names and values), same-seed repeat and different-seed difference against the real binary, the stream number in the result, and that generate() does not request -LOG or -STREAMS. Review follow-up: a BEGIN STREAM inside an open stream now raises; generate_parameter_log's stream is dsqgen's -STREAMS stream and generate(stream_id=) does not select a stream, so for a stream above 0 the logged values do not match generate()'s SQL (documented in the docstring; render the SQL for that stream from the values with generate_with_parameters, PR #2510, or with generate_dsqgen_streams). Unverified: log identity of the non-darwin-arm64 bundled binaries (dfparity-t15).
description: Extend DSQGenBinary (benchbox/core/tpcds/c_tools.py, _build_dsqgen_cmd) to pass -LOG <file> and add a parser returning per-template substituted parameters (names like YEAR.01, MONTH.01) including the stream (BEGIN STREAM n). Tested facts: -LOG works, the same -RNGSEED gives an identical log, a different seed changes it, 99 invocations take about 3 s; -QUALIFY Y does not change values. The log records base variables only (Q39 logs MONTH.01 but the SQL also uses [MONTH]+1), which downstream adapters must handle. Extends the orphaned benchbox/core/tpcds/parameter_extractor.py (no production callers since commit 72d167081, #2126); do not add more regex SQL scraping.
